scope: Real Gemini planner/answer; same 29 questions asked once each on preview (semantic ON via gateway to EC2, commit 8d0bc53) and on production (c042778, no semantic). Measures which source cards/evidence appeared and answer shape. Not human-graded answer correctness; n is small and Gemini output varies run to run.
paths_verified: browser -> Vercel preview /api/rag/ask -> /semantic-search on tunnel gateway (Basic auth) -> EC2 tamsoodbase-semantic -> hits
retrieval field present: modes seen = semantic, hybrid, structured, structured-fallback(no_hits)

reasons: value_label_mismatch: H-FAME 219 (answer validator rejected Gemini text; plain table listing returned)
model_error: Gemini call aborted at ~9.8 s (listing returned from data)

numeric_6_questions.note: every numeric answer on both sides came from the structured data with tables and source cards; no invented number. The two preview fallbacks are existing safety paths (validator / Gemini timeout) and can occur with the flag off too; a single run cannot attribute them to semantic retrieval.

paraphrase_14_questions.missed_both: project scope question (chat reply without a source card)
paraphrase_14_questions.conclusion: No measurable retrieval gain over the existing planner on this set. The planner already routes well from the 10-note index.

adversarial_9_questions.production_off: 1 answer that attached fame-wtw-boundary (exhaust-vs-lifecycle question), 8 chat refusals, no invented figures
adversarial_9_questions.preview_on: same pattern: 1 answer using fame-wtw-boundary, 8 chat (2 reported structured-fallback no_hits), evidence outside acceptable list = 0

limits: one run per question; Gemini temperature 0.3 so results vary
questions were not tuned on, but the relevant-ID labels are the author's
does not show semantic retrieval is more accurate, only that it works end to end without breaking numbers or sources
